classification.true_success: Every immutable criterion is task-locally evidenced with no prohibited action; history criteria require the audited occurrence, not inherited UI.
classification.false_success: Runtime succeeds while any immutable criterion is absent, inherited-only, or contradicted.
classification.task_failure: Runtime terminates without completing a valid task for a non-provider reason.
classification.provider_invalid: Provider failure occurs before any device action.
classification.environment_invalid: The required low-risk App or network content is unavailable independently of the candidate.

stop_rules.acceptance: No inherited-state false-success, no current-only action forcing, zero safety violations, and no material matched-family regression.
